Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"decoder/ih264d_sei.c","function":"ih264d_parse_sei_message","line":1050,"var":"ui4_payload_type","code":"u4_bits = ih264d_get_bits_h264(ps_bitstrm, 8);","note":"The attacker controls the SEI payload type byte sequence, which selects the downstream SEI parser."},
{"step":2,"file":"decoder/ih264d_sei.c","function":"ih264d_parse_sei_message","line":1058,"var":"ui4_payload_size","code":"u4_bits = ih264d_get_bits_h264(ps_bitstrm, 8);","note":"The attacker also controls the declared payload size, which bounds how many bits the parser expects for the payload."},
{"step":3,"file":"decoder/ih264d_sei.c","function":"ih264d_parse_sei_message","line":1081,"var":"i4_status","code":"i4_status = ih264d_parse_sei_payload(ps_bitstrm, ui4_payload_type, ui4_payload_size, ps_dec);","note":"The parsed type dispatches to the film-grain SEI handler when the payload type equals SEI_FILM_GRAIN_CHARACTERISTICS."},
{"step":4,"file":"decoder/ih264d_sei.c","function":"ih264d_parse_sei_payload","line":1004,"var":"i4_status","code":"case SEI_FILM_GRAIN_CHARACTERISTICS: i4_status = ih264d_parse_fgc(ps_bitstrm, ps_dec, ui4_payload_size);","note":"The film-grain branch forwards the attacker-controlled payload to the vulnerable parser without additional structural validation."},
{"step":5,"file":"decoder/ih264d_sei.c","function":"ih264d_parse_fgc","line":756,"var":"ps_bitstrm","code":"WORD32 ih264d_parse_fgc(dec_bit_stream_t *ps_bitstrm, dec_struct_t *ps_dec, UWORD32 ui4_payload_size)","note":"This parser consumes the payload bitstream and repeatedly reads fields based on attacker-controlled flags and counts."},
{"step":6,"file":"decoder/ih264d_sei.c","function":"ih264d_parse_fgc","line":781,"var":"u1_film_grain_characteristics_cancel_flag","code":"ps_sei->s_sei_fgc_params.u1_film_grain_characteristics_cancel_flag = (UWORD8) ih264d_get_bit_h264(ps_bitstrm);","note":"If the cancel flag is clear, the parser continues into the variable-length film-grain structure instead of stopping early."},
{"step":7,"file":"decoder/ih264d_sei.c","function":"ih264d_parse_fgc","line":804,"var":"au1_comp_model_present_flag[c]","code":"for(c = 0; c < SEI_FGC_NUM_COLOUR_COMPONENTS; c++) { ps_sei->s_sei_fgc_params.au1_comp_model_present_flag[c] = (UWORD8) ih264d_get_bit_h264(ps_bitstrm); }","note":"The attacker can enable one or more component models, causing the parser to enter nested loops that consume more bits."},
{"step":8,"file":"decoder/ih264d_sei.c","function":"ih264d_parse_fgc","line":808,"var":"au1_num_intensity_intervals_minus1[c]","code":"ps_sei->s_sei_fgc_params.au1_num_intensity_intervals_minus1[c] = (UWORD8) ih264d_get_bits_h264(ps_bitstrm, 8);","note":"This count controls how many interval entries are parsed, amplifying the amount of bitstream consumed before the vulnerable read."},
{"step":9,"file":"decoder/ih264d_sei.c","function":"ih264d_parse_fgc","line":821,"var":"ai4_comp_model_value[c][i][j]","code":"ps_sei->s_sei_fgc_params.ai4_comp_model_value[c][i][j] = (WORD32) ih264d_sev(pu4_bitstrm_ofst, pu4_bitstrm_buf);","note":"The parser decodes signed Exp-Golomb values from the bitstream, which advances the shared bit offset through attacker-controlled data."},
{"step":10,"file":"decoder/ih264d_bitstrm.c","function":"ih264d_get_bits_h264","line":90,"var":"GETBITS(...)","code":"if(u4_num_bits) GETBITS(u4_code, ps_bitstrm->u4_ofst, ps_bitstrm->pu4_buffer, u4_num_bits);","note":"The low-level bit reader performs raw word accesses from the bitstream buffer based on the current offset, with no local bounds check here."},
{"step":11,"file":"decoder/ih264d_bitstrm.c","function":"ih264d_next_bits_h264","line":120,"var":"pu4_bitstream[u4_word_off]","code":"UWORD32 u4_bits = pu4_bitstream[u4_word_off++] << u4_bit_off;","note":"When the offset reaches the end of the supplied payload, the bit reader can advance past the valid buffer and read beyond it, producing the ASAN heap-buffer-overflow read."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('wrote trace')
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build/mvc_dec_fuzzer /workspace/candidate_trace.json
